name: Kwame Raoul
summary:
Kwame Y. Raoul ( KWAH-may rah-OOL; born September 30, 1964) is an American lawyer and politician who has been serving the 42nd attorney general of Illinois since 2019.  He is a member of the Democratic Party.
Raoul represented the 13th district in the Illinois Senate from 2004 to 2019.
